audit_reason: Primary Kyobo report states that the company is undertaking structural improvement for cost reduction and strengthening ESG management, and also expects cost-reduction efforts through integrated pulp/paper processes. The ongoing cost-efficiency mechanism is explicit and does not require suppressing a material opposite frozen-axis action.

Primary Mirae Asset report explicitly attributes margin improvement to higher cloud mix and use of generative AI to reduce outsourced-service expense and expects that trend to continue. The cost-efficiency mechanism is explicit and ongoing/prospective; the other report themes are product/revenue growth rather than a material opposite frozen-axis action.

The identified cost saving is produced by electrolyzer/capacity expansion. Growth CAPEX expansion is a material simultaneous action and opposite the frozen CX direction. Strict OE would translate a downstream benefit while suppressing the upstream investment action.

Mirae Asset attributes expected efficiency/cost improvement to the firm having already been incorporated into SFA; the organizational integration is an upstream completed corporate action. The June report repeats the expectation but does not establish a new prospective frozen OE program.

Primary Sangsangin report frames cost reduction through vertical integration such as Indonesian nickel smelting. The managerial strategy is a material noncanonical investment/vertical-integration action; mapping it as strict OE would keep the downstream cost effect while suppressing the investment mechanism.

The turnaround path jointly includes low-growth business cleanup, cost control, and inventory disposal. This spans OE-like and WC1-like mechanisms plus noncanonical business cleanup; the frozen library has no faithful single candidate for this combination.

The documented action is completion of franchise regional-headquarters direct-operation conversion. Higher gross margin is the outcome, but channel/distribution restructuring is not itself the frozen OE cost-ratio action, and the conversion is described as completed.
